_why: BY_TWIN is a dict literal, so deleting a name removes a check and the tick simply reports one fewer entry - no failure, no signal. This repo diagnosed exactly that hole in rapp-sentinel and kept it. This file is the REQUIRED set; s_checks_complete compares it against what actually ran.
_note: prove.py proves each guard FIRES, not that it RUNS. A check removed from BY_TWIN but still defined keeps a passing scenario, because the harness calls checks.<name>() directly.
_adding: Add the id here in the same commit. Extras are reported without failing, so a new check never breaks the loop before someone lists it.
_removing: Delete it here deliberately, in a commit that says why.
